sources.snippet: An end-to-end time-series forecasting project built with Python, TensorFlow/Keras, and Scikit-Learn. This repository demonstrates how to preprocess multi-variable weather data, construct sliding sequence windows, and train a Recurrent Neural Network (SimpleRNN) to forecast ambient temperatures.
